holder-quote: Hate the fact that she was Fierre the Vampire, not Fierre the [Broker] or Fierre the [Opener].
she paced the small room she operated as one of Reizmelt’s few Openers. One of three, in fact. The class [Opener] was a specific, stylistic one
Fierre was an Opener. Even if she didn’t have the class, she opened letters, paid Runners for their secrets, and negotiated the sale of information.
